description: Maps repository directory names to project slugs for the engineering journal pipeline. GitHub full repo names (`owner/repo`) are the canonical key linking worklogs to projects.
rules: Every worklog entry MUST list the GitHub repo(s) (`owner/repo`) it actually worked on in its `github_repos` frontmatter field.
Every `github_repos` entry must resolve to a known project: a published work in `src/content/works/` (via its `github_repos`) or a `repos` registry entry.
When a day's work spans multiple repos, list them all in `github_repos` and give each project its own `### Project name` section.
When publishing a new project, add its GitHub repo(s) to the `repos` registry until it has a work page.
